\]
is sufficient for asymptotic minimaxity. Suppose in addition that \(d_t\to\infty\). This sufficient condition is not necessary, even up to relabeling coordinates within blocks. There are asymptotically minimax weights for which the last display equals \(2\) for every sufficiently large \(t\).

defs.def:block-score-energy: For \(d\ge1\) and a \(d\)-coordinate Bernoulli vector, set \(g_d(z):=\sum_{r=1}^{\bar\beta_d}\frac{\Delta_r(p)}{[p(1-p)]^r}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}\\|S|=r}}\prod_{j\in S}(z_j-p)\), \(A_d:=\sum_{r=1}^{\bar\beta_d}\binom{d}{r}\Delta_r(p)^2/[p(1-p)]^r\), and \(h_d:=g_d/A_d=\sum_{T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}}h_{d,T}\prod_{j\in T}z_j\), the last equality being the raw-monomial expansion.
defs.def:local-linear-class: On the fixed graph \(G_t\), set \(\mathcal M_t(G_t):=\{c:c_{i,S}=0\text{ unless }S\subseteq N_i^{G_t}\text{ and }|S|\le\bar\beta_{d_t},\ \sum_{S\subseteq N_i^{G_t}}|c_{i,S}|\le B\text{ for every }i\in V_{n_t}\}\). Set \(\mathcal E_t^{\mathrm{loc,lin}}:=\{\widehat\tau_{w,t}=n_t^{-1}\sum_{i\in V_{n_t}}w_{i,t}(Z_{b(i)})Y_i(Z):w_{i,t}\in L^2(P_Z)\text{ is measurable with respect to }Z_{b(i)},\ \mathbb E_Z[w_{i,t}]=0,\text{ and }\mathbb E_Z[w_{i,t}\prod_{j\in S}Z_j]=1\text{ for every nonempty }S\subseteq N_i^{G_t}\text{ with }|S|\le\bar\beta_{d_t}\}\). Define \(R_t^{\mathrm{loc,lin}}:=\inf_{\widehat\tau_{w,t}\in\mathcal E_t^{\mathrm{loc,lin}}}\sup_{c\in\mathcal M_t(G_t)}\mathbb E_Z[(\widehat\tau_{w,t}-\tau_{n_t})^2]\); the graph is fixed and is not varied in this supremum.

assumptions.ass:bernoulli-design: \(Z_j\) are mutually independent and \(\Pr(Z_j=1)=p\) for every \(j\in V_n\).

snapshot.stmt: For \(B>0\) and \(1\le d\le n\), the graph \(G_{n,d}^{\mathrm{blk}}\) in \({\rm def:block-family}\) belongs to \(\mathcal G_{n,d}\), and each schedule in the support of \(\Pi_\sigma\) belongs to \(\mathcal C_{n,d,\beta}(B)\). In particular, the support of \(\Pi_\sigma\) is contained in \(\mathcal M_{n,d,\beta}(B)\).

defs.def:model-class: \(\mathcal M_{n,d,\beta}(B):=\{(G_n,c):G_n\in\mathcal G_{n,d},\ c\in\mathcal C_{n,d,\beta}(B)\}\), where \(\mathcal G_{n,d}\) and \(\mathcal C_{n,d,\beta}(B)\) are the classes in \({\rm def:graph-class}\) and \({\rm def:coefficient-class}\), respectively.
defs.def:block-family: For \(B>0\) and \(1\le d\le n\), set \(m:=\lfloor n/d\rfloor\), \(q:=md\), and \(\rho:=q/n\). Partition \(q\) units into \(m\) blocks \(V_b\) of size \(d\); include every within-block directed arrow, including loops, and leave the remaining \(n-q\) units isolated. Set \(s:=B/2\), \(f_s(u):=s^{-1}\cos^2(\pi u/(2s))\mathbf1\{|u|\le s\}\), and draw \(U_1,\ldots,U_m\) independently from \(f_s\). Let \(H_{\beta,p}:=\sup_{d\ge1}\sum_T|h_{d,T}|\) and choose \(\delta:=B\min\{(2H_{\beta,p})^{-1},(4\pi)^{-1}\}\min\{1,\sqrt{A_d/m}\}\). Under \(\Pi_\sigma\), active \(i\in V_b\) has \(c_{i,T}:=U_b\mathbf1\{T=\varnothing\}+\sigma\delta h_{d,T}\) for \(|T|\le k_\star\), and all other coefficients, including those of inactive units, are zero. The \(U_b\) randomize fixed potential-outcome schedules only; they are not observation noise.

assumptions.ass:bounded-degree: Self-loops are allowed and count in both degrees, with \(\max_{i\in V_n}|N_i|\le d\) and \(\max_{j\in V_n}|\{i\in V_n:j\in N_i\}|\le d\).
